info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get P2m By Settlement Id-spec
info.description: The P2M Settlement Retrieval API enables users to access detailed information about Payment to Merchant (P2M) transactions using a unique settlement ID. This endpoint is designed for financial institutions, payment processors, and developers who need to obtain transaction summaries and statuses. By querying the API with the specific settlement ID, clients can retrieve relevant data including transaction amounts, dates, and related merchant information. Use cases include reconciliation processes, auditing, and providing insights for financial reporting.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve detailed information about a specific settlement identified by its ID. You can use this to check the status, involved parties, and financial records associated with the settlement.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve settlements for the specified RES-100045 identifier. It requires the necessary parameters to filter and return the specific data related to operations for the given resource.

200.description: The request was successful and the settlement details are returned.

GetP2mBySettlementIdRequest.description: A string representation of the request body for the GET operations related to settlements.
